name: Destructo-Bot: a Tinker dying while possessing it releases the bot (#265)
contract: Build: Destructo-Bot 804673 'Build a Destructo-Bot that you can see through and directly control.' Its
summon effect names creature 50300 with SummonProperties 65, a puppet: the Tinker possesses the bot, and
dying ends that control like any possession. #265 reported an ABORT in Player::StopCastingCharm
(Unit::Kill -> setDeathState -> RemoveAllControlled) on release feb155c82, where the bot was charmed without
a charm aura or puppet summon. Killing the possessing Tinker must leave it dead with its own character
back under control, the bot gone and the server running.

steps.label: The build spell possesses its Destructo-Bot
The Tinker dies while possessing the bot
The Tinker controls its own character again
